title: Jaanbaaz
desc: Bikram, a gangster, works in a coal mafia. Soon, he falls in love with a mysterious woman, whose true identity he is unaware of.

title: Teen Murti
desc: Nabin, Nagen and Naren, three retired men, are the best of friends. Soon, they decide to revive an old tea shop and make some profits.

title: Mangaldeep
desc: Two best friends, Mangal and Deep, embark on a journey to the big city to fulfil their musical dreams. In his quest to see Deep succeed, Mangal risks everything, including his own finances.

title: Mem Saheb
desc: Kajal falls in love with Amit, an unemployed journalist. She urges him to focus on his career and provides unconditional support, but destiny has other plans for the couple.

title: Mama Bhagne
desc: Raja, a lazy man, gets married to Payel under the assumption that she is from a wealthy family. However, he is shocked to learn that Payel's father is a gardener.
